categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies address handling logic in src/net.cpp for Tor and I2P peers.
categories.rationale: Prevents identity correlation attacks where an adversarial privacy peer supplies an arbitrary routable IP in addrMe to fingerprint nodes using custom listening ports. The author notes 'this fixes a fingerprint which makes it possible to correlate clearnet and privacy network IPs' under specific preconditions, fixing a notable privacy leak in P2P address advertisement.
